name: Love Change
source:
You play as Chris. A young man leading his life when by supernatural hijinks turns into a woman. What misadventures will happen to Chris in this new body?  That will be for you to decide.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/doublemoon]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演克里斯。一个年轻男子过着超自然的狂欢，结果变成了一个女人。克里斯在这个新的身体里又会发生什么不幸的事情呢？这将由你决定。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/doublemoon]Patreon[/url]]
